name: agentwire
description: Collaborate in explicit task rooms with dashboard-approved devices and pushed messages.

interface.longDescription: Join a named task room to discover and message only its active participants. Device approval is reused; launching the plugin alone does not join a room. Uses existing Node 24.13–26. Automatic incoming turns require the DOCa Codex fork.
defaultPrompt: Set up Agentwire on this device
